title: Configure idevice-backup
description: Global options for the iOS backup module

retention.title: Backups to keep per device
retention.description: How many backup snapshots to keep per device; older ones are pruned after a successful backup.

include_backups.title: Include device backups in the NS8 backup
include_backups.description: Add the (potentially large) device backups to this module's NS8 backup. Off by default; only pairing records and the registry are carried.

selfservice_host.title: Self-service host name (FQDN)
selfservice_host.description: FQDN for the user self-service portal, published through Traefik. Leave empty to disable the portal.

ldap_enabled.title: Enable LDAP/AD login for the portal

ldap_bind_dn.title: Bind DN
ldap_bind_dn.description: Service account used to look up users.

ldap_bind_password.title: Bind password
ldap_bind_password.description: New password of the service account; empty keeps the stored one. Stored in state/passwords.env.

ldap_group.title: Group
ldap_group.description: Only members of this group (also nested AD groups) may log in: a group name, for an LDAP server of its own also a DN; empty allows every user.

selfservice_restore.title: Allow users to restore their own devices

ldap_domain.title: User domain
ldap_domain.description: User domain of the cluster whose users may log in to the portal (ldap_source domain); also recorded as owner domain of new devices.

selfservice_path.title: Self-service path (optional, e.g. /idevice)
selfservice_path.description: Serve the portal under this path on the host instead of at the root. Empty = at the host root.

autobackup_enabled.title: Automatic backups
autobackup_enabled.description: Back up devices automatically on a schedule.

autobackup_interval_hours.title: Backup interval (hours)
autobackup_interval_hours.description: Minimum hours between automatic backups per device. The hourly timer retries devices that were asleep.

ldap_source.title: Directory
ldap_source.description: domain: a user domain of this cluster (no credentials stored in the module); custom: an LDAP server entered here.

ldap_start_tls.title: StartTLS
ldap_start_tls.description: Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS.

ldap_tls_verify.title: Verify the server certificate
ldap_tls_verify.description: Check the LDAP server certificate against the system CAs (ldaps:// or StartTLS).

ldap_schema.title: Directory type
ldap_schema.description: ad (Active Directory, Samba) or rfc2307 (OpenLDAP posixAccount).

notify_mail_to.title: Overdue mail to
notify_mail_to.description: Address that gets a mail through the cluster smarthost when a device has had no successful backup for notify_overdue_days; empty = no admin mail.

notify_owners.title: Mail the device owners
notify_owners.description: Also mail the owner (address read from the directory at portal login).
